title: VanishHand
description: Vanishes Items in your main hand
body:
This mod introduces a simple yet drastic mechanic : **any item** held in the player's main hand **instantly disappears**. The moment a player equips something, it is automatically removed without delay or warning, and there's no way to get it back.

This pushes the player rethink his stategies, because a single error can be **fatal**.

Lightweight, simple, and multiplayer compatible !

# Q & A

<details>
<summary>Is there a by-pass ?</summary>
The vanish occurs every tick, so it's about 50ms to check if your main hand has something.
</details>
